title: Bad Strategy
coreMove: Spot when strategic language is covering an absent diagnosis and no real choice.
sourcePressure: This chapter isolates recurring failure patterns: plans that sound energetic while missing diagnosis, dodging tradeoffs, piling initiatives, or failing to use leverage already present in the situation. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Bad strategy is merely a weak plan, poor execution, or low morale.
